nodes.name: RootLayout
nodes.summary: Next.js root layout component. Configures Inter and JetBrains Mono Google fonts, imports global CSS, and wraps all page content in the Providers client component. Defines app metadata (title, description) and viewport settings.

nodes.name: Providers
nodes.summary: Client-side provider wrapper that composes SessionProvider (next-auth), VoiceChatProvider, VoiceChatButton, and Toaster into a single tree. Consumed by RootLayout to bootstrap all client-side providers.

nodes.name: CodeZonePage
nodes.summary: Main page implementing a social feed / community platform with cinematic dark UI. Supports authenticated post creation, like/comment/share interactions, and feed filtering (featured, rising, following). Uses a 'signal' themed aesthetic with nebula backgrounds, iridescent effects, and animated loaders.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining the design system. Declares @theme CSS variables for all color tokens (light and dark modes), border radii, and sidebar/chart palettes. Includes custom keyframe animations (fadeInUp, shimmer, cursorPulse, bracketGlow, slideInScale, etc.) and Monaco editor UI enhancements (animated selections, bracket matching, suggest widgets, minimap shadows).

nodes.name: middleware
nodes.summary: Next.js edge middleware for route-level authentication. Checks JWT tokens via next-auth; returns 401 JSON for unauthenticated API requests and redirects unauthenticated page requests to /auth/login. Only protects /api/execute and /api/submissions/:path* routes.

nodes.name: auth
nodes.summary: NextAuth v5 configuration with multiple authentication strategies: Credentials (email + password via bcrypt), Google OAuth, and GitHub OAuth (conditionally enabled via env vars). Uses PrismaAdapter for session persistence and JWT for session strategy. Extends the Session type to include id, username, and image. Auto-generates usernames for OAuth sign-ups with collision handling.

nodes.name: prisma
nodes.summary: Singleton Prisma client with build-time safety. Conditionally constructs PrismaPg adapter only when DATABASE_URL is present to prevent build crashes on Vercel. Reuses the client across hot-reloads in development via globalForPrisma.

nodes.name: admin
nodes.summary: Admin role verification helper. Parses ADMIN_EMAILS from env (comma-separated), compares against the current session email, and returns an {ok, session} discriminated union for use in admin API routes.

nodes.name: httpErrors
nodes.summary: Error mapping utilities that convert Prisma known errors to HTTP status codes. Handles P2002 (unique constraint -> 409), P2025 (not found -> 404), and defaults other errors to 400.

nodes.name: utils
nodes.summary: Tiny utility providing a cn() function that merges clsx conditional classes and tailwind-merge for deduplicating Tailwind utility conflicts.

nodes.name: debug
nodes.summary: Comprehensive debug logging system for AlgoMentor with color-coded ANSI output across 8 subsystems (MENTOR, CACHE, AI, STAGE, EMBED, DB, RATE, PATTERN). Includes performance timers (startTimer, timeAsync), interaction tracing (traceInteraction), and in-memory log history with filtering, stats, and clear capabilities. Controlled by DEBUG or NODE_ENV=development env vars.

nodes.name: startup
nodes.summary: Server startup health check system. Validates required/optional environment variables, tests database and Redis connectivity, warms up the embedding model, and performs a cache warmup. Provides runStartupChecks() for initialization and getHealthStatus() for runtime health reporting (ok/degraded/down). Also includes async health probes for Groq API, embedding model, and DB.

nodes.name: rateLimit
nodes.summary: Distributed rate limiting with sliding window algorithm. Primary backend uses Redis sorted sets; falls back to in-memory Map for development. Exposes checkRateLimit() for AI calls (20/hour), checkHintLimit() per problem (max 4 hints), checkPlanLimit() for FREE users (5 problems/day), plus increment/reset/status primitives and a generic slidingWindowLimit function.

nodes.name: api-key-pool
nodes.summary: API key management pool with round-robin rotation and per-key cooldown. Supports multiple Groq and OpenRouter API keys from env vars (GROQ_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY_1...N, etc.). Implements health tracking, exponential cooldown on 429/5xx errors, automatic recovery, and status reporting via poolStatus() and allPoolStatuses().

nodes.name: request-coalesce
nodes.summary: Request deduplication utility. Prevents redundant concurrent identical async calls by tracking in-flight promises in a Map. When a duplicate key arrives, it awaits the existing promise instead of executing a new call. Used to coalesce identical AI queries from multiple users.

nodes.name: Navbar
nodes.summary: Top navigation bar with brand link ('Aether AI'), page navigation links (Home, Problems, Leaderboard, Discussions), and user avatar. Uses next-auth session data for profile display.

nodes.name: Sidebar
nodes.summary: Collapsible left sidebar navigation with icon-only default view that expands on hover. Contains links to Workbench (home), Architect (problems), Leaderboard, and Settings. Includes branding element with 'Aether' name.

nodes.name: ApiOnboardingDialog
nodes.summary: Multi-step onboarding dialog for AI provider configuration. Supports 6 providers: Server Default, Google AI (Gemini), Groq, OpenAI, OpenRouter, and Ollama (local). Each provider has a welcome screen, selection card with pricing/rating badges, and a configuration form for API keys. Uses sonner toasts for success/error feedback. Saves settings via PATCH /api/settings/ai.

nodes.name: AuthRequiredDialog
nodes.summary: Authentication required dialog prompting users to sign in. Offers three sign-in options: default credentials, Google OAuth, and GitHub OAuth. Includes a link to the registration page for new users.

nodes.name: Markdown
nodes.summary: Minimal custom Markdown renderer with no external dependencies. Supports headings (h1-h3), paragraphs, and fenced code blocks with language tags. Uses HTML escaping for security and renders via dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Optimized with React.useMemo.

nodes.name: MentorChat
nodes.summary: AI mentor chat interface for coding problems. Accepts problem metadata (ID, title, statement, constraints, test cases) and user code as props. Sends messages to /api/mentor with optional pre-flight syntax checking via /api/syntax-check. Displays conversation history with loading indicators and error handling.

nodes.name: VoiceChat
nodes.summary: Full voice chat implementation using Web Speech API. Features speech recognition (push-to-talk and continuous modes), speech synthesis for AI response playback, and a minimizable floating card UI. Connects to /api/voice-chat endpoint. Supports browser compatibility detection with alerts for unsupported browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari supported).

nodes.name: VoiceChatButton
nodes.summary: Floating action button that opens the VoiceChat panel. Uses VoiceChat context to toggle visibility. Positioned at bottom-right of the screen with a tooltip. Hidden when the voice chat panel is already open.

nodes.name: VoiceChatProvider
nodes.summary: React context provider for voice chat state management. Exposes isOpen, openChat, closeChat, and toggleChat via useVoiceChat hook. Manages isOpen and isMinimized state. Conditionally renders VoiceChat as a child when open.

nodes.name: shadcn/ui config
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui component configuration specifying New York style, RSC mode, TSX support, Tailwind CSS integration, Lucide icon library, and path aliases (@/components, @/components/ui, @/lib, @/hooks with CSS vars).

nodes.name: Providers
nodes.summary: Client provider wrapper composing SessionProvider, VoiceChatProvider, VoiceChatButton, and Toaster into a single render tree.

nodes.name: CodeZonePage
nodes.summary: Main page component rendering the social feed. Fetches posts via API, handles post creation, displays a cinematic UI with feed filters, user avatars, timestamps, like/comment/share buttons, and code snippet rendering.

nodes.name: getTimeAgo
nodes.summary: Relative time formatter that returns human-readable time strings ('Signal Live' for <60s, 'Xm', or 'Xh').

nodes.name: RootLayout
nodes.summary: Root layout function rendering the HTML shell with configured font variables and dark background, wrapping children in Providers.

nodes.name: middleware
nodes.summary: Edge middleware function that validates JWT authentication tokens. Returns 401 JSON for unauthenticated API requests and redirects page requests to /auth/login with callback URL preservation.

nodes.name: normalizeBaseUsername
nodes.summary: Sanitizes a username string by trimming, lowercasing, replacing spaces with underscores, and removing non-alphanumeric characters except underscores.

nodes.name: ensureOAuthUsername
nodes.summary: Auto-generates a username for OAuth users who lack one. Tries the base username first, then appends random suffixes on collision. Falls back to a unique username using the user ID as suffix.

nodes.name: createPrismaClient
nodes.summary: Constructs a PrismaClient, optionally with PrismaPg adapter when DATABASE_URL is available. Falls back to default client construction when the connection string is missing (build-time safety).

nodes.name: requireAdmin
nodes.summary: Async function that retrieves the current session, parses admin emails from env, and returns a discriminated union indicating whether the user is an admin.

nodes.name: parseAdminEmails
nodes.summary: Parses a comma-separated ADMIN_EMAILS env var into a normalized array of lowercase emails.

nodes.name: isPrismaKnownError
nodes.summary: Type guard to check if an unknown error is a PrismaClientKnownRequestError.

nodes.name: prismaErrorToHttp
nodes.summary: Maps Prisma error codes to HTTP status codes: P2002->409 (conflict), P2025->404 (not found), default->400 (bad request).

nodes.name: cn
nodes.summary: Combines clsx and tailwind-merge to merge Tailwind class names, resolving conflicts where conflicting utilities overlap.

nodes.name: debug (object)
nodes.summary: Namespace object containing 8 subsystem-specific loggers (mentor, cache, ai, stage, embed, db, rate, pattern). Each logger outputs color-coded, timestamped messages with optional structured data.

nodes.name: startTimer
nodes.summary: Creates a performance timer that logs elapsed time when stopped. Measures using performance.now() and only logs when debug is enabled.

nodes.name: timeAsync
nodes.summary: Wraps an async function to automatically measure and log its execution time via startTimer.

nodes.name: traceInteraction
nodes.summary: Traces the full lifecycle of a mentor interaction, logging start/completion/failure with timing information. Used to instrument the mentor AI request pipeline.

nodes.name: getLogHistory
nodes.summary: Returns recent log entries from in-memory history, filterable by system and limit.

nodes.name: clearLogHistory
nodes.summary: Clears the in-memory log history buffer.

nodes.name: getLogStats
nodes.summary: Returns a count breakdown of log entries by subsystem.

nodes.name: runStartupChecks
nodes.summary: Orchestrates all startup checks: env validation, database connection, Redis connection, embedding warmup, and cache warmup. Times the entire process and logs a formatted summary.

nodes.name: getHealthStatus
nodes.summary: Runtime health check that probes all subsystems (DB, Redis, Groq, embeddings, cache) in parallel and determines overall status as ok, degraded, or down.

nodes.name: slidingWindowLimit
nodes.summary: Core sliding window rate limit implementation. Uses Redis sorted sets when available (with pipeline for atomicity); falls back to in-memory Map when Redis is absent. Returns allowed/remaining/resetAt/retryAfterMs.

nodes.name: checkRateLimit
nodes.summary: Public function to check AI call rate limits. Allows 20 AI calls per user per hour with a descriptive remaining/limited message.

nodes.name: checkHintLimit
nodes.summary: Checks hint limits per problem/user via DB session currentRung (max 4 hints). Fails open on DB errors.

nodes.name: checkPlanLimit
nodes.summary: Enforces daily problem limits for FREE plan users (5/day). PRO and TEAM plans are unlimited. Counts distinct problems via MentorSession queries. Fails open on DB errors.

nodes.name: getKeyFromPool
nodes.summary: Gets the next healthy API key via round-robin selection. Creates pool from env on first call. Recovers keys whose cooldown has expired. Returns least-cooled-down key as last resort when all keys are in cooldown.

nodes.name: reportKeyFailure
nodes.summary: Reports an API key failure. Applies incremental cooldown (429: 60s/120s/180s/240s, 5xx: 30s). Marks key unhealthy after MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES failures.

nodes.name: poolStatus
nodes.summary: Returns health status of all keys in a provider pool, including success rates, cooldown status, and failure counts.

nodes.name: allPoolStatuses
nodes.summary: Returns pool status for all providers (groq, openrouter).

nodes.name: coalesce
nodes.summary: Executes an async function with request deduplication. Returns true if caller should execute (new request), false if it was deduplicated and another in-flight request provided the result.

nodes.name: ApiOnboardingDialog
nodes.summary: Multi-step dialog (welcome -> provider selection -> configuration) for AI provider setup. Supports server default, Google AI, Groq, OpenAI, OpenRouter, and Ollama. Saves configuration via PATCH /api/settings/ai with sonner toast feedback.

nodes.name: AuthRequiredDialog
nodes.summary: Dialog prompting unauthenticated users to sign in via credentials, Google, or GitHub OAuth. Links to registration page.

nodes.name: Markdown
nodes.summary: Renders a subset of Markdown (headings h1-h3, paragraphs, fenced code blocks) to sanitized HTML using React.useMemo for performance optimization.

nodes.name: escapeHtml
nodes.summary: Escapes HTML special characters (&, <, >, ", ') for XSS prevention when rendering Markdown to HTML.

nodes.name: MentorChat
nodes.summary: AI mentor chat UI. Sends user messages to /api/mentor with problem context, test cases, and optionally pre-checked syntax errors from /api/syntax-check. Displays conversation with loading states.

nodes.name: VoiceChat
nodes.summary: Voice chat panel with speech recognition and synthesis. Handles push-to-talk, continuous listening modes, auto-play of AI responses, minimize/expand states, and fallback alerts for unsupported browsers. Communicates with /api/voice-chat.

nodes.name: VoiceChatButton
nodes.summary: Floating tooltip-triggered button that opens/closes the VoiceChat panel via context.

nodes.name: VoiceChatProvider
nodes.summary: React context provider managing voice chat open/minimized state. Exposes useVoiceChat hook for consumers.

nodes.name: useVoiceChat
nodes.summary: Hook to access VoiceChat context. Throws if used outside VoiceChatProvider.

nodes.name: Navbar
nodes.summary: Sticky top navigation bar with brand, page links, and user avatar powered by session data.

nodes.name: Sidebar
nodes.summary: Collapsible sidebar with icon navigation that expands on hover for label visibility.

nodes.name: ProblemsPage
nodes.summary: Problems listing page organized into curated coding patterns with search, grid/list toggle, expandable problem lists, difficulty badges, and a sidebar showing global skill sync and recent activity.

nodes.name: ProblemDetailPage
nodes.summary: Individual problem view with split-panel layout: left panel for problem description or AI mentor chat, right panel with Monaco code editor. Supports animation visualization and mentor API integration.

nodes.name: ProfilePage
nodes.summary: User profile page displaying stats, streak calendar, ranking chart, achievements, and problem history. Includes editable profile dialog updating name, bio, social links, languages, skills, and quotes.

nodes.name: SettingsPage
nodes.summary: API settings page for configuring AI provider selection among server, Groq, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and Ollama with conditional form fields for each provider's API keys and configuration.

nodes.name: LeaderboardPage
nodes.summary: Competitive leaderboard with top-3 podium display, countdown timer, and ranked table showing user avatars, followers, points, and rewards with load-more pagination.

nodes.name: LoginPage
nodes.summary: Login form supporting credentials-based email/password sign-in and OAuth via Google or GitHub. Includes loading states, error handling, and links to registration.

nodes.name: RegisterPage
nodes.summary: Registration form with email, username, name, and password confirmation validation. Calls register API on submit with success/error feedback and redirect to login.

nodes.name: AuthErrorPage
nodes.summary: Auth error display component wrapped in React Suspense, reading the error query parameter and providing a link back to login.

nodes.name: AdminPatternsPage
nodes.summary: Admin panel for creating and listing coding patterns with name and description. Protected by ADMIN_EMAILS restriction.

nodes.name: AdminProblemsPage
nodes.summary: Admin panel for creating, listing, and navigating to problem editor. Creates new problems with default stubs for test cases and starter code across four languages.

nodes.name: AdminProblemEditPage
nodes.summary: Full problem editor supporting slug, title, difficulty, publish toggle, Markdown statement and constraints, pattern associations, hints, public/hidden test cases, multi-language starter code, and animation uploads (SVG/Canvas/Lottie) with file upload support.

nodes.name: EmbeddingDebugPage
nodes.summary: Debug UI for testing the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding pipeline with tabs for storing Q&A pairs, generating embeddings, searching with similarity threshold and stage filters, viewing stored entries, and a live log console.

nodes.name: MentorLogPage
nodes.summary: Debug UI with three tabs for monitoring AI mentor interactions: live log (placeholder), session history with expandable messages showing stage/rung/role, and cache DB viewer with cached response inspection. Supports auto-refresh polling.

nodes.name: AnimationPlayer
nodes.summary: Interactive visualization player for DSA algorithm animations supporting SVG rendering and Canvas-based simulation with play/pause/step controls, speed adjustment, progress seeking, array-based interactive inputs, and fullscreen toggle.

nodes.name: Avatar
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Avatar composite component wrapping Radix Avatar primitives with Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback, AvatarBadge, AvatarGroup, and AvatarGroupCount sub-components.

nodes.name: Badge
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Badge component using class-variance-authority for variant styling (default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link) with asChild support via Radix Slot.

nodes.name: Button
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Button component with class-variance-authority variants for style (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and multiple sizes, with asChild support.

nodes.name: Card
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Card composite component with Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, and CardFooter sub-components for structured card layouts.

nodes.name: Dialog
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Dialog composite wrapping Radix Dialog with overlay, portal, header, footer, title, description, and close components. Depends on Button for footer close action.

nodes.name: DropdownMenu
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui DropdownMenu wrapping Radix dropdown-menu primitives with full sub-component set including sub-menus, checkboxes, radio items, labels, separators, and shortcuts.

nodes.name: Form
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Form integration with react-hook-form providing FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage, and useFormField hook for accessible form validation.

nodes.name: Input
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Input component styling a native input element with focus, accessibility, and file-upload state support.

nodes.name: Label
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Label component wrapping Radix Label primitive with disabled and peer-disabled state support.

nodes.name: Select
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Select wrapping Radix Select with trigger, content, items, groups, labels, separators, scroll buttons, and value display. Supports popper positioning.

nodes.name: Toaster
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Toaster wrapping Sonner with next-themes integration and custom icons for success, info, warning, error, and loading toast states.

nodes.name: ProgressItem
nodes.summary: Renders a horizontal progress bar with label and percentage value for skill metrics display.

nodes.name: NavLink
nodes.summary: Simple navigation link with active state styling and uppercase tracking for the top navbar.

nodes.name: sendMentorMessage
nodes.summary: Sends a user message to the AI mentor API endpoint, appends to local message history, and handles success/error states for the chat interface.

nodes.name: handleSubmit
nodes.summary: Validates registration form (password match, length checks) then submits to register API with redirect on success.

nodes.name: handleSubmit
nodes.summary: Submits credentials via next-auth signIn with redirect on success or error display on failure.

nodes.name: handleOAuthSignIn
nodes.summary: Initiates OAuth sign-in flow for Google or GitHub provider via next-auth signIn.

nodes.name: fetchMe
nodes.summary: Fetches current user profile data from API endpoint with error handling.

nodes.name: fetchPatterns
nodes.summary: Fetches all patterns from admin API for display in the pattern management list.

nodes.name: fetchProblems
nodes.summary: Fetches all problems from admin API for display in the problem management list.

nodes.name: createProblem
nodes.summary: Creates a new problem via API with default test cases and starter code templates for four languages, then navigates to the editor.

nodes.name: fetchProblem
nodes.summary: Fetches a single problem by ID from admin API and normalizes JSON fields for the editor form.

nodes.name: parseTests
nodes.summary: Parses text blocks separated by --- into structured test case objects with input, expected output, and hidden flag using regex matching.

nodes.name: FileUploadInput
nodes.summary: File upload input component that reads SVG/JSON/JS files directly for small files or uploads to cloud storage for larger files through the animations upload API.

nodes.name: SVGViewer
nodes.summary: Renders SVG animation data with speed control and fullscreen toggle, using dangerouslySetInnerHTML for SVG content.

nodes.name: CanvasSimulation
nodes.summary: Full interactive canvas simulation engine that parses animation code, computes algorithm steps, renders on canvas with grid background, and provides playback controls and interactive array inputs.

nodes.name: table.tsx
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Table component with composable sub-components (TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, etc.).

nodes.name: tabs.tsx
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Tabs component built on Radix UI primitives.

nodes.name: textarea.tsx
nodes.summary: Simple textarea component with Tailwind styling.

nodes.name: tooltip.tsx
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Tooltip component using Radix UI Tooltip primitive.

nodes.name: embeddings.ts
nodes.summary: Embedding generation and similarity computation for caching AI mentor responses using multiple model providers.

nodes.name: gemini-rephrase.ts
nodes.summary: Gemini-powered text rephrasing utility for generating alternative phrasings of mentor hints.

nodes.name: groq.ts
nodes.summary: Core AI integration layer handling Groq, OpenAI, OpenRouter, and Ollama model calls for the mentor system with streaming, caching, and fallback logic.

nodes.name: piston.ts
nodes.summary: Piston API client for running code submissions in sandboxed environments across multiple languages.

nodes.name: mentorContext.ts
nodes.summary: Mentor interaction context builder providing problem state, user progress, and conversation history for AI prompt generation.

nodes.name: mentorQuestions.ts
nodes.summary: Generates context-appropriate Socratic questions for the mentor to ask users at different stages of problem solving.

nodes.name: mentorSystemPrompt.ts
nodes.summary: Constructs the system prompt template for the AI mentor, defining its behavior and teaching methodology.

nodes.name: openrouterModels.ts
nodes.summary: OpenRouter model catalog and configuration for available AI models.

nodes.name: hintLadder.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the hint escalation system that progressively reveals more information based on user struggle patterns.

nodes.name: interactionRouter.ts
nodes.summary: Routes user interactions in the mentor system to appropriate handlers based on intent and conversation state.

nodes.name: patternTracker.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks coding patterns and user weaknesses across problems to provide personalized learning recommendations.

nodes.name: stageEngine.ts
nodes.summary: Manages the multi-stage mentoring flow (Explore, Plan, Implement, Reflect) and tracks user progression through each stage.

nodes.name: adminProblem.ts
nodes.summary: Zod validation schemas for admin problem creation and updates, including test case normalization.

nodes.name: aiPreferences.ts
nodes.summary: Manages user AI provider preferences and API key settings.

nodes.name: mentor.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript type definitions for the mentor system including stages, interactions, and conversation state.

nodes.name: speech.d.ts
nodes.summary: Type declarations for the Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition, SpeechSynthesis).

nodes.name: schema.prisma
nodes.summary: Prisma schema defining the complete data model including User, Problem, Post, MentorSession, and related entities with 20+ models.

nodes.name: seed.js
nodes.summary: Database seed script that populates initial problems, users, and related data.

nodes.name: seed-frequent-questions.ts
nodes.summary: Seed script for populating mentor frequent questions with embedding generation.

nodes.name: next.config.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js configuration with React strict mode and image domains.

nodes.name: prisma.config.ts
nodes.summary: Prisma client configuration for database connection.

nodes.name: NextAuth Route Handler
nodes.summary: NextAuth handler that exports GET and POST handlers from lib/auth. Sets runtime to nodejs.

nodes.name: User Registration Endpoint
nodes.summary: User registration endpoint. Handles POST requests to create new users with email, username, and password. Validates uniqueness, hashes passwords with bcryptjs, and creates user records via Prisma.

nodes.name: Problems Listing Endpoint
nodes.summary: Problems listing endpoint. Returns all published problems with their slug, title, difficulty, updatedAt, and associated patterns. No authentication required.

nodes.name: Problem Detail Endpoint
nodes.summary: Single problem detail endpoint. Fetches a problem by slug or id, including patterns, hints (ordered), and public test cases. Returns 404 for unpublished or missing problems.

nodes.name: Code Run Endpoint
nodes.summary: Code execution endpoint using Piston. Authenticated POST that runs user code against public test cases only, tracks userProblemStats (runCount, acceptedCount, wrongAnswerCount, runtimeErrorCount), and reports pass/fail per test. Does not expose hidden test cases.

nodes.name: Code Submit Endpoint
nodes.summary: Code submission and auto-grading endpoint. Similar to run but also tests against hidden test cases. Updates bounded per-user-per-problem stats via upsert. Never leaks hidden test inputs or expected outputs to the response.

nodes.name: Posts Feed and Creation Endpoint
nodes.summary: Post creation and feed endpoint. GET supports multiple feed types (following, featured, rising, all) with cursor-based pagination and like/comment counts. POST creates a new post with content, optional code snippets, images, and auto-extracts hashtags. Updates trending topics on post creation.

nodes.name: Comments Endpoint
nodes.summary: Comment endpoint for posts. GET fetches comments with cursor-based pagination and user info. POST creates a comment (requires auth), validates post exists, and atomically increments the post's commentCount via a Prisma transaction.

nodes.name: Post Like/Unlike Endpoint
nodes.summary: Post like/unlike endpoint. POST creates a like and increments likeCount atomically via transaction. DELETE removes the like and decrements. Both require auth. Prevents duplicate likes and unlikes.

nodes.name: User Profile Endpoint
nodes.summary: Current user profile endpoint. GET returns the authenticated user's profile including name, bio, location, links, languages, skills, and quote arrays. PATCH allows updating these fields with type-safe filtering.

nodes.name: User Follow/Unfollow Endpoint
nodes.summary: User follow/unfollow endpoint. POST creates a follow relationship (with self-follow prevention and duplicate check). DELETE removes it. Both require authentication.

nodes.name: Channel Follow/Unfollow Endpoint
nodes.summary: Channel follow endpoint. Creates or removes channelFollow records for the authenticated user. Prevents duplicate follows.

nodes.name: AI Settings Management Endpoint
nodes.summary: AI settings management endpoint. GET fetches user's AI configuration (provider, API keys masked, model, verbosity, onboarding status). PATCH upsertes userAiSettings with validation of the API provider enum (server, groq, openai, google, openrouter, ollama).

nodes.name: Voice Chat Endpoint
nodes.summary: Voice chat processing endpoint. Takes a message and conversation history, builds a voice-optimized system prompt (concise, conversational), and calls either OpenRouter or OpenAI depending on AI_PROVIDER env var. No database access.

nodes.name: Health Check Endpoint
nodes.summary: API health check endpoint. Delegates to getHealthStatus from lib/startup which checks database connectivity, Redis, Groq API, embedding model, cache entries, and server uptime. Returns 200/203/503 based on health.

nodes.name: Code Execute Endpoint
nodes.summary: Code execution (protected by middleware). Runs user code through the Piston API with per-language support for JavaScript, Python, Java, and C++. Wraps code in language-specific harnesses, runs test cases, and compares outputs.

nodes.name: Fix Model Endpoint
nodes.summary: Temporary endpoint to fix user's preferred AI model. Upserts userAiSettings to set preferredFreeModel to a specific Deepseek model. Requires authentication. One-time utility endpoint.

nodes.name: Syntax Check Endpoint
nodes.summary: Syntax checking via Piston endpoint. Runs a best-effort compilation/parse check without full test execution. Detects syntax errors via stderr analysis for JavaScript, Python, Java, and C++.

nodes.name: Trending Topics Endpoint
nodes.summary: Trending topics endpoint. Returns TrendingTopic records ordered by weekCount descending, then postCount. Supports limit query parameter. No authentication required.

nodes.name: Coding Patterns Endpoint
nodes.summary: Coding patterns listing endpoint. Fetches all patterns with their associated published problems, sorted by name ascending. Filters out unpublished problems from the results.

nodes.name: Top Discussions Endpoint
nodes.summary: Top discussions endpoint. Returns posts from the last 7 days with the most comments, ordered by commentCount descending. Supports limit parameter.

nodes.name: Admin Problems List/Create Endpoint
nodes.summary: Admin problem management endpoint. GET lists all problems (admin check temporarily disabled). POST creates a new problem with Zod-validated schema, normalizing test cases and creating related problemPatterns, hints, and testCases in a Prisma transaction.

nodes.name: Admin Problem Detail/Update Endpoint
nodes.summary: Admin problem update/delete endpoint. GET returns full problem details with patterns, hints, and testCases. PATCH updates a problem including scalar fields, pattern associations, hints (full replacement), and test cases (full replacement) in a transaction. Uses Zod validation and Prisma error handling.

nodes.name: Admin Patterns Endpoint
nodes.summary: Admin pattern management endpoint. GET lists all patterns. POST creates a new pattern with admin guard. Simpler CRUD compared to admin problems.

nodes.name: AI Mentor Endpoint
nodes.summary: Main AI mentor interaction endpoint (1466 lines). Socratic teaching engine with 4-layer rate-limit defense (per-user limiting, global cache, request coalescing, API key pool). Implements a 6-stage teaching pipeline (Explore, Strategize, Implement, Debug, Stuck, Reflect) with learning rung detection, tone analysis, solution-request gating, output sanitization, conversation memory, and graceful AI failure fallback. Supports Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, and Ollama providers with automatic key rotation.

nodes.name: resolveApiConfig
nodes.summary: Resolves API configuration with priority chain: user key (BYOK) > server key pool (Groq round-robin > OpenRouter). Supports retry loop for 429 responses. Returns apiKey, apiBaseUrl, model, provider, and isServerKey flag.

nodes.name: callAIWithKeyRotation
nodes.summary: Makes LLM API calls with automatic key rotation on 429 errors. Falls back to the next key in the server pool when the current one is rate-limited. Uses exponential backoff retry via llmFetchWithRetry.

nodes.name: buildMentorSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Constructs the full system prompt for the AI mentor by combining base prompt, stage instructions, tone, verbosity, contextual guidance, problem context, user code, stats, conversation history, and guide questions.

nodes.name: sanitizeAssistantResponse
nodes.summary: Output guardrail that prevents the AI from leaking full solutions. Allows only tiny illustrative snippets unless allowFullSolution is true. Detects full-solution indicators like code length, class definitions, and specific phrases.

nodes.name: clampDbText
nodes.summary: Utility function that truncates text to a maximum of 800 characters, appending a truncation indicator showing the original length.
